ios.desc:
NEED ACCESS RIGHT NOW?
FORGOT SOMETHING ON YOUR COMPUTER?

Your computer, anywhere you are.
Access your Mac or PC securely from your phone or tablet – anytime, anywhere.

Whether you’re traveling, helping family, or need something urgently from your Mac or PC, Splashtop gives you fast, reliable remote access in seconds.
No complicated setup.
No lag.
Just control.

GET STARTED IN 3 STEPS

1. Install Splashtop on your phone or tablet

2. Install the free Splashtop Streamer on your computer

3. Log in and connect instantly. That’s it.

WHAT PEOPLE USE SPLASHTOP FOR

• Accessing full apps, files, and tools they left at home
• Working remotely when plans change
• Helping parents or friends fix computer issues
• Staying productive while traveling
• Getting peace of mind knowing their computer is always reachable

WHY SPLASHTOP

Splashtop is trusted by millions of users and IT teams worldwide for one reason:
it works when it matters.

• ULTRA-FAST
Smooth, high-resolution streaming with low latency.

• SIMPLE SETUP
Install, log in, and connect. No IT degree required.

• SECURE
Bank-grade encryption keeps your data and your screen private.

• RELIABLE
Works even on limited bandwidth or mobile data.

This is the same remote access technology used by professionals – made simple for personal use.

FREE VS ANYWHERE ACCESS

• FREE
Access your computer on the same local network

• ANYWHERE ACCESS (UPGRADE)
Securely connect from anywhere, on any network

When remote access becomes important – not just occasional – upgrading unlocks full freedom without changing tools.

KEY FEATURES

• Access your Mac or Windows computer anytime
• High-quality audio & video streaming
• Low-latency remote control
• Blank screen mode for privacy
• Remote webcam access
• Cross-platform support (Windows, Mac, iOS)

PERSONAL VS BUSINESS

Splashtop Personal is designed for non-commercial use.
For work or teams, try Splashtop Business for advanced features and management.

A REMOTE ACCESS TOOL YOU CAN TRUST

When your computer matters, access shouldn’t be complicated.
Splashtop gives you control, clarity, and confidence – wherever you are.

See our Terms of Service and Privacy policy at https://www.splashtop.com/terms/splashtop.

ACPU API is minimal

https://github.com/d08ble/acpul-demo/tree/master/sys

This is another demo 100k particles on iPad 2 (9700-9740 files):

This is true usable like TV remote control. Or you can make game with real virtual desktop.

ACPUL interpreter is very fast like LUA, performance near to native C. It also export code to many platforms like Haxe http://haxe.org/ (current implementation run on iOS only)

ACPU is new paradigm of LiveCoding. ACPU should never crash. ACPU is bug-free.
